'''Asori Rogriss''', born in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], was the daughter of [[Teren Rogriss]], an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. When Teren Rogriss defected in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] promised to get word to her and offer her and her brother Terek the opportunity to escape the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and join him.
